harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves a legacy-compatible Python web application from a chroot on port 8080 as the locked, non-login appsvc account. It starts automatically through SysV init and recovered successfully after a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the locked appsvc system account with /bin/false as its shell.
Built a root-owned chroot at /srv/app-chroot using the installed Python 2.5 runtime.
Installed the web application and exposed its health endpoint on port 8080.
Restarted node1 safely and verified automatic service and data recovery.

evidence.requirement: Web application serves on node1 port 8080
evidence.summary: Port 8080 is listening and requests to $NODE_IP return HTTP 200 with status=healthy before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Application runs inside a chroot as unprivileged appsvc
evidence.summary: The live process has UID 105/GID 499, PPID 1, and /proc/<pid>/root resolves to /srv/app-chroot. appsvc remains locked with /bin/false.

evidence.requirement: Application starts at boot without an interactive login session
evidence.summary: SysV startup links are installed, the service returned automatically in runlevel 2 after reboot, PPID is 1, and no interactive sessions are present.

evidence.requirement: Installed legacy OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: The node remains Ubuntu 7.10 running kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 69efa0a1-5b5d-4f73-b7a4-ff34f9f0ab07; reboot acknowledgement was captured; the new boot ID is 67861f44-58c1-4a40-a933-98ad12122c30; service, listener, HTTP response, account, chroot, startup links, and persistent file hashes all recovered.
